answer: Put political party membership hash with party attestation at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. A farm running 679 aliases would need 679 separate proofs, each costing about 101 POA or 15 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. What carries the knoll here is verification, the dawn of cost is what stops the farm, and the thread of the record keeps every claim checkable. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
